programs.title: Treasures Decoded 2
programs.desc: A group of specialists from various fields will carefully examine: the pyramid of Cheops, statues from Easter Island, busts of Nefertiti, Blackbeard's ship, the Ark of the Covenant and the Spear of Destiny.

programs.title: Planet Earth III
programs.desc: The third part of the nature documentary, produced over almost five years, concludes the trilogy almost two decades after the first series was broadcast.Its creators used pioneering film technologies, including:light drones, super-fast cameras and remotely controlled deep-sea submarines.In eight episodes, viewers will visit the most remote jungles, the darkest ocean depths, the world's largest caves and the hottest deserts and steppes.They will learn the story about nature's will to survive and the adaptive abilities of various species.The Earth is at a tipping point and changes in the natural world are felt in every ecosystem and affect numerous creatures.The series highlights the growing need to protect and restore nature.In the last episode, viewers will meet inspiring people from various corners of the world who are the face of change and saving the Earth.They are committed to risking their lives to protect the planet.Sir David Attenborough will guide the series.

programs.title: Wild London
programs.desc: A famous naturalist reveals the nature present in the landscape of his native London.It presents extraordinary stories taking place in the center of the metropolis, including:peregrine falcons nesting on the parliament building.

programs.title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough's Greatest Adventure
programs.desc: Sir David Attenborough, a great advocate of wildlife and popularizer of science, celebrates his 100th birthday.On this occasion, BBC Earth presents the extraordinary journey of this outstanding naturalist and traveler.

programs.title: Life in Colour with David Attenborough
programs.desc: Traveler and naturalist David Attenborough will take viewers on a journey through the colorful world of nature.Discover the strategies of animals using colors for various purposes.Peacocks, baboons, tigers and chameleons use colors to attract attention or hide their presence and protect themselves and their loved ones.Animals found in various corners of the Earth use their own colors or those found in the environment to survive, attract a partner, convey information, scare away predators or protect their territory.The creators will use amazing shots and frames to show the beauty of the world around us, but also the cunning and strategies that animals use to survive.
